dragonfarm's tools for an ellmer chat or an MCP client

Source: R/ellmer_tools.R
dragon_ellmer_tools.Rd

Turns dragonfarm's tool contracts (search a document set, answer from it, read documents, list sets and runs, check a run) into ellmer tools, so any ellmer chat, with any model, can use your documents and runs. Every call goes through the same checks as inside dragonfarm: arguments are checked against the tool's contract, an agent is held to the current policy (some calls are refused, some wait for a person), and every call is recorded in the catalogue's event log.

Usage

dragon_ellmer_tools(agent = NULL, tools = NULL)

Arguments

agent

Name the caller as an agent in the policy (for example "answer"), so its calls are checked against what that agent may do. NULL (the default) means a person acting directly.

tools

Which tools to include, by name. NULL includes all.

Value

A list of ellmer tool definitions.

Details

To offer them to Claude Desktop, Claude Code, or another MCP client, serve them with the mcptools package, for example mcptools::mcp_server(tools = dragon_ellmer_tools()).

Examples

if (requireNamespace("ellmer", quietly = TRUE)) {
  names(dragon_ellmer_tools())
}
#>  [1] "answer_question"          "cancel_run"              
#>  [3] "check_answer"             "evaluate_run"            
#>  [5] "list_document_sets"       "list_runs"               
#>  [7] "promote_model"            "read_documents"          
#>  [9] "recall_training"          "run_status"              
#> [11] "scan_personal_data"       "search_documents"        
#> [13] "train_model"              "verify_document_set"     
#> [15] "write_practice_questions"
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
chat <- ellmer::chat_anthropic()
chat$register_tools(dragon_ellmer_tools())
chat$chat("What do my FDA guidances say about covariate adjustment?")
} # }
